items.source: true if the handler was subscribed or false if it was already subscribed.
items.translation: true 表示订阅了该处理器，或 false 表示已订阅。

items.source: true if the handler was un-registered, or false if was not registered.
items.translation: 如果已取消注册处理器，则返回 true；否则返回 false。

items.source: A MessageChannel that maintains a registry of subscribers and invokes them to handle messages sent through this channel.
items.translation: 一个维护订阅者注册表并调用它们以处理通过此通道发送消息的MessageChannel。
